text_block_list.text:
While walking down the hallway, Agnes Tachyon
suddenly called out to me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-kun, look at that.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Can you tell? At the end of the hallway...
Around the landing.
Told that, I strained my eyes to look—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Kuhu, kufufu...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume girls bounding up
and down the stairs...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Does she have wings?
An angel? Is she an angel? She IS an angel~!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Do you understand?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. She and I are roommates.
She truly is quite an intriguing individual."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: For example, I hear Digital-kun observes Umamusume as a hobby, but—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Even the slightest anomaly that I might miss, she doesn't let slip by!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Your stride is shorter than yesterday," or
"Your footsteps sound different than usual," and so on!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What incredible observation skills!
Truly an eye-opening display!
choice_data_list: You really love Umamusume, don't you?
You really love Umamusume, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
We simply must ask for her cooperation!
Trainer-kun, please convince her!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I... or rather, whenever an Umamusume calls out to her,
she seems to tense up.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, if I'm with you, maybe even that
might be alleviated. I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Aah?! Those girls just held hands!!
Looking a little flustered with slightly wandering gazes!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And the way their hands intertwined...
It started with their fingertips touching, right?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: No way... This is way too good of a reward...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, excitement MAX EXTRA...!
I can't take any more stimulation than this!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hyawawa!? Are you
Tachyon-san's Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Tachyon-san herself is here too...!
Ah, just as enchanting as she was this morning!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Do you have a moment?
Actually, I have something—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Just being roommates is humbling enough,
and yet you even talk to me outside our room...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hiyaaahn! I'm so happy, but my heart's pounding!
*pant, pant* Wait! Let me mentally prepare myself!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: H-Hold on a moment! I'm not finished speaking...!
choice_data_list: Oh, look, someone dropped a rare Umamusume photobook!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: H-Hold on a moment! I'm not finished speaking...!
choice_data_list: Oh, look, someone dropped a rare Umamusume photobook!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, intriguing!
Challenge accepted, Digital-kun!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"You must certainly tell me all about
that extraordinary observational eye of yours!"

Alongside Agnes Tachyon, I chased around Agnes Digital,
who was fleeing in total frenzy—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I won't let you get away, Digital-kun!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Squee! The way your ears twitched along with your sigh after saying "I won't" was the absolute best!! I wuv it!

After running continuously for about an hour...
I ended up losing sight of them.

"I couldn't even ask for their help, but...
even while just chasing after them, Agnes Tachyon
seemed to have learned something."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaaat!? Where, where!?
Where's that secret photo album of the Umamusume!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Nice one, Trainer!
Let's keep going and secure Digital!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaaa!?

The moment Agnes Tachyon held
Agnes Digital in a full nelson from behind—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaaaaaat!?
An Umamusume's warmth on my back--!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What the?! My body temperature is suddenly spiking—!

...Agnes Digital collapsed
into a limp heap.
In the end, asking for her cooperation was completely out of the question, but Agnes Tachyon seemed to have learned something from their brief exchange nonetheless.
